name: wiki-ticket-sdd-ui
description: Local read-only dashboard for any WikiTicket SDD (worklog) repo

scripts.build: npm run -w web build && npm run -w server build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w server typecheck && npm run -w web typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w server test && npm run -w web test
scripts.verify: npm run check:readonly && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.wireframes: plantuml -tpng docs/ui/wireframes/*.puml && mkdir -p docs/images/wireframes && cp docs/ui/wireframes/*.png docs/images/wireframes/
